title: Creamy Pastel Portuguese Cheesecake
description: A rich and creamy cheesecake with a pastel-colored crust, inspired by traditional Portuguese flavors. This dessert is perfect for special occasions or everyday treats.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the granulated sugar and beat until combined.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, followed by the melted butter.
Stir in the Greek yogurt and mix until smooth.
Pour the cheesecake batter into the prepared pie crust.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Dust with light powdered sugar before serving. Garnish with chopped fresh mint leaves, if desired.
